title: A Treatise on the Erosion of Guards
summary: A treatise on wearing down a qi guard from the outside until a patient hand can drive through it.

title: The Smothering Dust Canon
summary: A canon on thick dust that dulls breath and strength and settles over a group until it cannot rise.

title: Canon of the Living Grain Field
summary: A canon on spreading qi as a field of living grains that strike hold and hide at the user's will.

title: The Basin Sediment Treatise
summary: A treatise on laying sediment in basin layers and pressing the layers down on one foe at once.

title: Twin-Court Manual of Paired Dunes
summary: A manual of sand worked in pairs of waves and crescents that meet on one foe from opposite sides.

title: Hawk's-Flight Canon of the Dust Stoop
summary: A canon of dust trailed behind a hawk-like dive and a raking sweep of sand talons upon the chosen foe.

title: Oath-Book of the Wind-Worn Grain
summary: A book of sand sworn to hold a bearing and wear down whatever stands against the sworn line.

title: Plateau Treatise on Unwalled Sand
summary: A treatise on sand spread across open ground with no wall to stop it and no edge to its reach.

title: The Bearing of the Shifting Dunes
summary: A manual on taking a bearing across moving sand and striking along it while the ground keeps changing.
